page.overview:
Who is Almarian?

Almarian was a Queen of Númenor during the early Second Age.

Almarian was the daughter of a Númenórean sailor Vëantur, the Captain of the King's Ships under Tar-Elendil. She was married to Tar-Meneldur and she was mother of Aldarion, the future Tar-Aldarion, who was the sixth King of Númenor.

She cared little for ships and the sea, though her father was a great sailor. She married and gave birth to a son, Aldarion, who soon desired to follow in the footsteps of her father, Vëantur. This later displeased his father, who wanted him to marry and settle down. However, Almarian supported her son in everything he did and later served as a mediator between her husband and their son on matters regarding his life choices.
